The problem

Sound familiar?

Things break mid-campaign

You're running paid traffic and something stops working. No one to fix it fast, no one who understands what can and can't be touched.

Development takes forever

A simple feature — two weeks. A redesign — three months. Your business can't wait while a developer "figures it out."

15 apps, 3 do the same thing

Your store is slow, bloated with overlapping apps, and nobody knows which ones are safe to remove without breaking something.

SEO requirements nobody implements

Your SEO agency sends a list of technical fixes. No one implements them correctly — or breaks the theme trying.

Red Core Web Vitals, slipping rankings

Google is penalizing your store, mobile conversions are suffering. Unclear who owns the fix — or how to make it stick.

Team can't touch the store

Every banner, every promo update goes back to a developer. Your team is blocked. Your store is the bottleneck.

What I do

Services

Execution-first. No buzzwords. Clean Liquid and JavaScript that performs, ranks, and holds up under pressure.

01

Shopify Stores from Scratch

From brand references and competitor inspiration to a live, structured storefront. Premium or free theme, any budget, any niche.

02

Custom Theme Development

Figma to Shopify builds. Custom sections and blocks, fully manageable via Theme Customizer — your team edits content without a developer.

03

Figma to Shopify

You bring the design file, I handle the full technical implementation. Clean execution, stable themes, SEO-friendly.

04

Liquid & JS Development

Advanced Liquid templating and JavaScript frontend work. Bespoke solutions where custom code does the job better than any app.

05

Campaign & Promo Landing Pages

Built for paid traffic (Meta, Google, TikTok), collection launches, seasonal campaigns, and limited drops - without touching core theme logic.

06

Technical SEO Implementation

I understand SEO at a technical level. Your team's requirements get implemented correctly — without breaking existing theme logic.

07

Performance Optimization

Core Web Vitals, mobile-first development, accessibility, page speed. Every build follows best practices from the ground up.

08

App Audit & Replacement

Identify what's slowing your store down. Replace heavy apps with lean custom code. Cut unnecessary subscription costs.

09

Bug fixes and broken flow repairs

Safe for live stores and active ad campaigns. Fully QA-tested before launch. Always on a duplicate theme.
